season: Primary infection green tip to ~3 weeks after petal fall; secondary through summer
symptoms: Olive-brown velvety spots on leaves; scabby, cracked fruit
favourable_weather: Leaf wetness hours needed for infection depend on temperature (revised Mills table, see rules_config.json). Infection is rare above ~26 C.
non_chemical: Compost fallen leaf litter or spray 5% urea on the orchard floor (HP 2026 point 8). Keep 12-14 day interval until the end of primary scab in scab-prone areas.
note: Do not repeat the same chemical. Dodine: do not tank-mix, do not spray above 30 C.
source_ref: HP Dept of Horticulture + UHF Nauni, Spray Schedule 2026 (Apple), eudyan.hp.gov.in/cms/media/fd3dr2c5/1699-horti-2026-eng.pdf; Penn State Extension apple scab review

symptoms: Combined class of the server model (ixrbhii apple ConvNeXt); rust is not recorded on apple in India (JoTT 2019 HP rust checklist)
note: Treat as scab but ALWAYS route to agronomist review because the rust half of the label is unlikely in Himachal.

season: Warm wet weather, mostly late season
symptoms: Frogeye leaf spot (purple-bordered brown spots); fruit rot
non_chemical: Sanitation: prune and remove cankered wood and mummified fruit
note: Present in Kashmir (Bhat et al., Sci Rep 2023); minor in Himachal (inferred). Zineb row in the HP 2026 schedule lists 'scab and black rot'.
source_ref: HP Dept of Horticulture + UHF Nauni, Spray Schedule 2026 (Apple), eudyan.hp.gov.in/cms/media/fd3dr2c5/1699-horti-2026-eng.pdf; Bhat et al. 2023

name_hi: सेब का सीडर रस्ट (भारत में दुर्लभ)
symptoms: Bright yellow-orange spots on leaves (North American disease)
non_chemical: No measures needed unless an expert confirms the disease
note: Not recorded on apple in India (JoTT 2019). Treat as a LOW-PRIOR prediction: probably a mis-classification (e.g. of scab or Alternaria). Always ask for a better photo and expert review.
No treatment needed.

name_hi: मार्सोनिना पत्ती धब्बा (समय से पहले पत्ते झड़ना)
season: From 2nd week of June; defoliation July-August (monsoon)
symptoms: Dark brown blotches on the upper leaf surface, yellowing and early leaf drop
favourable_weather: Mean temperature above 20 C with RH ~70% for 5-6 days (Thakur & Sharma 2010, V-s); infection needs >=6 h wetness, ~20 C optimum; >=40 h wetness for an epidemic. No validated Himachal forecasting model.
non_chemical: Better in open, well-pruned orchards; compost leaf litter
note: ONLY the server apple model (ixrbhii) has this class; no on-device model does. No dataset validated on Himachal field photos.
source_ref: HP Dept of Horticulture + UHF Nauni, Spray Schedule 2026 (Apple), eudyan.hp.gov.in/cms/media/fd3dr2c5/1699-horti-2026-eng.pdf; Nauni advisory July 2026; ICAR Indian Phytopathology abstracts

season: Monsoon (June-August); part of the premature leaf fall complex
symptoms: Round brown spots with darker rings; premature yellowing and leaf drop
favourable_weather: Same humid >20 C trigger as Marssonina (V-s)
note: On-device model does not have this class.
source_ref: HP Dept of Horticulture + UHF Nauni, Spray Schedule 2026 (Apple), eudyan.hp.gov.in/cms/media/fd3dr2c5/1699-horti-2026-eng.pdf; Nauni advisory July 2026

symptoms: Brown leaf spots (label from Chinese apple datasets)
note: INFERRED: in Chinese datasets 'brown spot' is typically the Marssonina leaf-blotch complex. Treat as Marssonina but send to agronomist.

symptoms: Grey leaf spots (label from datasets)
note: No entry in the HP 2026 schedule -> no recommendation; refer to expert.

season: Silvery terminals at bud break; spring-early summer
symptoms: White-grey powdery coating on shoot tips and young leaves
favourable_weather: Not quantified in HP sources. Granny Smith, Golden Delicious and Gala highly susceptible; Delicious types less (Kinnaur survey, V-s).
note: No model in our stack recognises it from a photo; shown for weather/stage advisories and manual selection.
source_ref: HP Dept of Horticulture + UHF Nauni, Spray Schedule 2026 (Apple), eudyan.hp.gov.in/cms/media/fd3dr2c5/1699-horti-2026-eng.pdf

symptoms: Yellowing, wilting and early leaf fall; basal bark lesions
non_chemical: Bordeaux paint on collar in winter; improve drainage
note: Not reliably diagnosable from a leaf photo (inferred) -> always expert review. Drench rules from HP 2026 points 10-11.
source_ref: HP Dept of Horticulture + UHF Nauni, Spray Schedule 2026 (Apple), eudyan.hp.gov.in/cms/media/fd3dr2c5/1699-horti-2026-eng.pdf

symptoms: Sunken bark lesions on branches
note: Not leaf-detectable. Post-harvest copper + mancozeb spray in HP 2026.
source_ref: HP Dept of Horticulture + UHF Nauni, Spray Schedule 2026 (Apple), eudyan.hp.gov.in/cms/media/fd3dr2c5/1699-horti-2026-eng.pdf

symptoms: Bronzed, stippled leaves
favourable_weather: Hot, dry weather favours; cool wet weather suppresses (10-18 day generations)
non_chemical: Keep insecticide use minimal in April-June to protect natural enemies; spray the basin too
note: Calendar/threshold advisories only; not image-detected.
source_ref: HP Dept of Horticulture + UHF Nauni, Spray Schedule 2026 (Apple), eudyan.hp.gov.in/cms/media/fd3dr2c5/1699-horti-2026-eng.pdf; Penn State

symptoms: Grey scale crusts on bark, red halos on fruit
non_chemical: Horticultural mineral oil at half-inch green tip
source_ref: HP Dept of Horticulture + UHF Nauni, Spray Schedule 2026 (Apple), eudyan.hp.gov.in/cms/media/fd3dr2c5/1699-horti-2026-eng.pdf

symptoms: Silvery scars on fruit and leaves
source_ref: HP Dept of Horticulture + UHF Nauni, Spray Schedule 2026 (Apple), eudyan.hp.gov.in/cms/media/fd3dr2c5/1699-horti-2026-eng.pdf

name_hi: सेब का वूली एफिड (सफेद रूई जैसा कीट)
symptoms: White cottony masses on bark and roots
source_ref: HP Dept of Horticulture + UHF Nauni, Spray Schedule 2026 (Apple), eudyan.hp.gov.in/cms/media/fd3dr2c5/1699-horti-2026-eng.pdf

season: Warm humid weather with splashing rain
symptoms: Small dark water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit
favourable_weather: Moderate temperature, high RH, splashing rain (NIPHM)
note: Copper is a protectant only (antibiotic sprays excluded from MVP).

symptoms: Brown concentric-ring spots on older leaves
source_ref: NIPHM AESA IPM packages, niphm.gov.in/IPMPackages; TNAU Agritech portal, agritech.tnau.ac.in/crop_protection

symptoms: Large water-soaked greasy lesions; white mould under leaves in humid weather
favourable_weather: NIPHM forecast rule: in 7 days, >=115 h at 7.2-26.6 C AND >=90 h with RH >85% -> blight expected within 10 days

symptoms: Yellow patches on top, olive mould below
note: No Indian label claim found -> refer to expert.

symptoms: Many small round spots with grey centres
favourable_weather: ~25 C with high humidity or dew (NIPHM)
source_ref: NIPHM AESA IPM packages, niphm.gov.in/IPMPackages; TNAU Agritech portal, agritech.tnau.ac.in/crop_protection

symptoms: Stippled, bronzed leaves with fine webbing
source_ref: NIPHM AESA IPM packages, niphm.gov.in/IPMPackages; TNAU Agritech portal, agritech.tnau.ac.in/crop_protection

symptoms: Brown spots with concentric rings
note: No Indian label claim found -> refer to expert.

name_hi: टमाटर का पत्ती मरोड़ (येलो लीफ कर्ल) वायरस
season: Hot, low-rain periods with whitefly build-up
symptoms: Upward leaf curling, yellowing, stunting
favourable_weather: Whitefly vector favoured by 28-36 C, RH 62-92%, scanty rain (NIPHM)
non_chemical: No cure. Net nursery, roguing, maize barrier rows, 10 yellow traps per acre, resistant varieties (Arka Rakshak, Arka Ananya)
note: Chemical control targets only the whitefly vector (see product master, use_note=vector_control).

symptoms: Mottled light/dark green leaves, distortion
non_chemical: No chemical control. Roguing, hygiene, disease-free seed, rotation
source_ref: NIPHM AESA IPM packages, niphm.gov.in/IPMPackages; TNAU Agritech portal, agritech.tnau.ac.in/crop_protection

note: No treatment needed.

season: Dry warm weather with intermittent rain
symptoms: Concentric-ring brown spots on older leaves
favourable_weather: 25-30 C, dry warm with intermittent rain (TNAU)

symptoms: Water-soaked lesions turning brown-black; white growth under leaves
favourable_weather: 10-25 C, RH >90%, cloudy/rain; NIPHM 7-day forecast rule (see rules_config.json)
source_ref: NIPHM AESA IPM packages, niphm.gov.in/IPMPackages; CPRI advisory

note: No treatment needed.

symptoms: Rectangular grey-tan lesions
favourable_weather: ~27-32 C, RH >90% for >=12 h (Crop Protection Network)
note: No Indian source found for chemical control -> refer to expert.

symptoms: Small brick-red pustules on both leaf surfaces

season: Moderate temperature with long leaf wetness
symptoms: Long cigar-shaped grey-green lesions

note: No treatment needed.

symptoms: Brown circular leaf spots with black dots; fruit mummies
favourable_weather: Needs ~24 h wetness at 10 C (Wikipedia, secondary)
note: Not a recorded problem in Indian viticulture (NRCG list has no black rot) -> refer to expert.

symptoms: Tiger-striped leaves, berry spotting, vine decline
non_chemical: Protect pruning wounds; remove infected wood (UC IPM)
note: No Indian chemical recommendation -> refer to expert.

symptoms: Angular dark spots on leaves
note: Product rows are mapped from the NIPHM anthracnose/leaf-blight row (mapping is inferred) -> expert review.
No treatment needed.
